review: The isolated WKWebView and AppKit batch completed 21 PASS lines, including zero sends and stale-target rejection.

TextEdit attached the native focus and content observer, then failed with unsupported before any write. The readiness probe accepted transient unsupported only for web snapshots. Its catch could mask an earlier, different error with a second unsupported read.

Chrome started the owned profile then reported unsupported before the observer was installed. Existing logging does not resolve which AX attribute was absent. An unguarded redundant snapshot required the setter before the bounded full-read wait.

The ASR changes do not edit the production input coordinator or accessibility client, or the two failing fixture sources in that CI revision. No attempt at focus activation or retrying a dispatch was added.

Updated fixture retains full PID, window, document, setter, content, caret, focus event and exact-range checks. An unavailable read breaks a quiet sequence. Build of the two edited fixtures with the real SaytileKit succeeded on M5; real host result belongs to subsequent CI.
